question: Which of the following international organisations celebrated its 80th anniversary on June 26, 2025, marking the signing of its charter?
solution: The correct answer is __**United Nations**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **United Nations (UN)** marks the **80th anniversary** of the signing of its foundational **Charter** on **June 26, 2025**. • The **UN Charter** was originally signed on **June 26, 1945**, in **San Francisco**, United States, at the conclusion of the **United Nations Conference on International Organization**. • Representatives of **50 countries** signed the document on that day, with **Poland** signing it later to become one of the **51 original member states**. • The **Charter** is the constitutive instrument of the **United Nations**, setting out the rights and obligations of **Member States** and establishing the principal organs and procedures of the organization. • While the **Charter** was signed in **June**, the **United Nations** officially came into existence on **October 24, 1945**, after the **Charter** had been ratified by the **five permanent members** of the **Security Council** and a majority of other signatories.
